title: Closure items before any further Finance extraction
statusReason: All four WP-0 items are resolved and verified where this environment can verify them. WP-0 changes no Finance runtime code; it changes evidence, documentation, one shared test and one provenance script. Workspace typecheck/build/test:finance-db were not re-run here (no pnpm, node_modules, database) and are not needed for these changes except as a final re-run after commit.

items.result: Base SHA 93ed6054... recorded from FIN-02D. Added scripts/antas/finance/provenance.mjs and reports/antas/finance/fin-provenance-manifest.json (41 Finance files, git-blob sha1). Algorithm cross-checked against git hash-object on a sample file (identical). Tamper test: edit detected (exit 1), restore passes (exit 0).

items.result: Diagnosed as a stale test, not a defect. CAPABILITY_AUTHZ_GATE defaults to 'enforce' (H9.2: src/index.mjs line 511; test header; sibling test 'default is enforce'). The report-mode test left it unset and expected 200 with scopes: [], so the correct fine-grained 403 MISSING_SCOPE tripped it. Fix: pin CAPABILITY_AUTHZ_GATE to 'off' in that one test so it isolates the coarse gate's report mode.
items.decision: Separate test-only fix, not a Finance baseline exemption.
items.verification: With workspace packages linked locally: before 11/12 pass (1 fail, the named test), after 12/12 pass.

items.result: Assigned to finance/application/reports.ts (read-only; reports.ts already owns getRateMap/toBase and imports projectsTable). Extraction itself deferred to the first WP-2 slice.

Workspace-wide test suite; only capability-gate was run for the shared-package change.
limitations: capability-gate fix touches a shared package outside Finance; review it as its own change and consider a separate commit.
Provenance proves content, not authorship or a commit; it becomes a SHA binding only after commit.
nextSafeStep: Commit in the Replit checkout (suggest two commits: the capability-gate test fix; then Finance extraction + evidence), run `node scripts/antas/finance/provenance.mjs --verify`, then start WP-1 (FIN-03 safety gate).
